title: Kubernetes API Server (Owlpane)
description: Control-plane metrics are not emitted by the default Owlpane agent.

panels.title: Requires apiserver scrape
panels.markdownContent:
**apiserver_*** and **kube-apiserver** recording rules come from **kube-prometheus** or a dedicated control-plane scrape — not from the default Owlpane agent Helm install.

- **Tier A (this product):** use **Kubernetes Cluster Resources (Owlpane)** and **Clusters Overview** for agent-backed cluster health.
- **Tier B:** install kube-prometheus (or enable apiserver metrics on your scrape config) and use dashboards under **Kubernetes (advanced / kube-prometheus)** in the library.

Layout inspired by community dashboards; Owlpane agent metrics use OTel **MetricName** values documented in METRICS-CONTRACT.md.
